title: Rice: a fast first harvest
applies_when: Plantable soil and a growing season remain, but food reserves are thin.
approach: Sow rice near camp, favoring rich soil when it is safely close. Its short growth cycle gets food in sooner than potatoes or corn.
Start a field the available grower can finish promptly, then expand from consumption and harvest yield. Do not use a fixed tiles-per-pawn rule as a guarantee.
Rice needs frequent sowing and harvesting. Keep some for quick recovery, but consider lower-labor crops after reserves improve.
verify: Native terrain fertility, light, temperature, harvest product and remaining season. Listed base grow days omit nightly rest and poor growing conditions.
reconsider: Poor fertility favors potatoes; secure reserves and limited labor favor corn.
